context.person: A person using an electric utility service
context.user_goal: Track the outage and use the named cooling center if needed.

product_state.preceding_state: A repair crew updated the expected restoration time after finding additional equipment damage.
product_state.current_state: Power remains out in the service area. The new estimate is 11:30 PM.
known_facts: Power remains out in the service area.
The estimate may change as repairs continue.
A cooling center is open at the West Community Center until midnight.
forbidden_claims: Power will definitely return at 11:30 PM.

current_content.message: There's an update. Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional sms so the person can understand power restoration estimate changed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Open directions to the cooling center.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Power remains unavailable and the restoration time is an estimate.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Track the outage and use the named cooling center if needed.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
